entities.name: Běla Kolářová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Běla Kolářová née Helclová was a Czech artist and photographer. In 1949 she married Jiří Kolář (1914-2002). In 1985, she followed her husband in exile in Paris. They returned to Prague in 1999. She died in Prague on 12 April 2010.
